_comment: Sign-in kind pat: the admin enters one token or API key on the Integration, and atrium sends it in one header.
Replace the example values: apiBasePath, a healthCheckPath that fails with a wrong credential, and the header the system reads. See docs/manifest.md in the SDK.

actions.name: list_items
